doc.name: TANDIU AI infrastructure data
doc.instructions: TANDIU publishes daily-updated data on LLM API prices, public benchmarks, a chain-linked price index, GPU prices (list, China market, cloud rental), self-hosting sizing for open-weights models on 18 GPUs, per-role token budgets, enterprise AI cost (API vs self-hosting on public cloud, private cloud or on-premises), cloud agents, coding-PC requirements, Chinese LLMs listed on overseas platforms, a Big Tech MCP access tracker (official MCP servers: auth, pricing, cross-border reachability measured by TANDIU) and AI funding rounds (company, round, amount, valuation, investors, sources). All tools are read-only. Prices are USD per 1M tokens unless stated; blended = (3*input+1*output)/4. Cite results as 'TANDIU (tandiu.cn)' with the source_url returned. Call about_tandiu_data first if you need the dataset overview. get_llm_price_history needs a TANDIU Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer ...; https://www.tandiu.cn/en/pricing); every other tool is free.

tools.name: about_tandiu_data
tools.title: Overview of TANDIU datasets
tools.description: What data TANDIU publishes, refresh cadence, price basis and how to cite. Call first.

tools.name: list_llm_prices
tools.title: LLM API prices and benchmarks
tools.description: Official API list prices (USD per 1M tokens) with Artificial Analysis, LiveBench 2.0 and Epoch AI scores for major US and Chinese LLMs. Filter and sort.

country.description: US, CN or another ISO code

tools.name: cheapest_model_for_score
tools.title: Cheapest model at a benchmark score
tools.description: Cheapest models whose benchmark score meets a threshold (absolute or percent of the best score).

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.title: LLM price index
tools.description: Chain-linked LLM price index (CN, US or all models), 30-day change, median price and series.

tools.name: get_llm_price_history
tools.title: LLM official price history (Pro)
tools.description: Pro (API key required): daily official list-price history per model since July 2026, USD and RMB per 1M tokens, with source URLs. Filter by model, vendor, country and date range.

model.description: model key or name substring, e.g. gpt-5.6, deepseek

tools.name: list_price_changes
tools.title: Recorded LLM price changes
tools.description: Official list-price cuts/increases observed in daily snapshots, and models newly added to tracking.

tools.name: estimate_self_hosting
tools.title: Self-hosting sizing
tools.description: VRAM, GPUs needed, single-stream and batched throughput, hardware cost and the vendor's official API price/speed for self-hosting an open-weights model. Omit model to list available models.

gpus.description: gpu ids from list_gpu_prices, e.g. h100_sxm, h20, ascend910b, rtx_pro_6000, rtx5090, rtx5090d

tools.name: list_gpu_prices
tools.title: GPU prices and specs
tools.description: Data-center, workstation and consumer GPUs (B300/B200/H200/H100/H20, Ascend 910B/910C/950DT (950DT figures indicative, from a circulated China Mobile test report), RTX PRO 6000/5500/5000, RTX 5090/5090D/4090D, L40S/L20): VRAM, bandwidth, FP16 compute, list price, China market price (SXM GPUs per 8-GPU node), cloud rental with 7-day change and daily median history (since 2026-10-18; few_samples flags thin markets), sources and dates. Rental comes from vast.ai; data-center GPUs include multi-GPU machines normalised per GPU; RTX 5090D/4090D have no rental (not listed on that market) and RTX 4090 is rental-only. Trend page: /en/gpu-rental.

query.description: gpu id or name substring, e.g. h20, rtx pro 6000, 910

tools.name: estimate_role_token_budget
tools.title: Token budget per job role
tools.description: Monthly token usage and cost for 32 common job roles at light / standard / heavy AI usage, with the best model (any country) and the best Chinese model that meet each role's capability floor.

query.description: role id or name, e.g. backend, lawyer, doctor

tools.name: estimate_enterprise_ai_cost
tools.title: Enterprise AI infrastructure cost
tools.description: Monthly AI cost for 10 / 100 / 1,000 / 10,000-person company samples across industries: API (per-role model choice, or the open model's official API) vs self-hosting the same open model on public cloud, private cloud or on-premises GPUs, with GPU count and cost per 1M tokens.

query.description: industry or sample, e.g. bank, hospital, ecommerce

include_gpu_breakdown.description: self-hosting cost on every GPU for each sample

include_hardware_table.description: per-GPU unit economics (throughput, hardware price, cost per 1M tokens)

tools.name: list_cloud_agents
tools.title: Cloud agents compared
tools.description: Cloud agents (Personal Agents, Work Agents, hosting platforms) with specs and monthly prices.

tools.name: recommend_coding_pc
tools.title: Computers for AI coding agents
tools.description: Relative speed and tier (best/recommended/minimum/not_advised) of Macs, laptops and desktops for running Codex / Claude Code.

tools.name: list_ai_funding
tools.title: AI funding rounds
tools.description: Funding rounds of AI companies (mainly US and China): company, business, round, amount, valuation, investors, source links. Newest first; filter by region, sector, company/investor name, date or minimum amount.

tools.name: list_overseas_listings
tools.title: Chinese LLMs on overseas platforms
tools.description: Where Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, ...) are listed on platforms headquartered outside mainland China: hosting type, regions, input/output/blended USD per 1M tokens vs the official price, context, tool calling, data-policy links. Labs ranked by Hugging Face followers, models by downloads and likes.

model.description: model name or key substring, e.g. deepseek v4 pro, kimi, glm-5

platform.description: platform name substring, e.g. together, bedrock

tools.name: find_mcp
tools.title: Big Tech MCP Access Tracker
tools.description: Official MCP servers of major US / Chinese / regional companies (payments, maps, finance data, collaboration, cloud, model platforms): transport, auth barrier, account requirements, pricing model, free quota (doc wording), daily cross-border reachability measured by TANDIU (China<->US handshake; evidence=probe), listing on MCP Registry / Claude directory. Facts only, no scores.

query.description: vendor or product substring, e.g. stripe, 高德

tools.name: get_mcp_changes
tools.title: Big Tech MCP access change events
tools.description: Append-only change events of tracked official MCP servers (terms/pricing pages, cross-border reachability, tools, status, directory listing) for the last N days, optionally for one entry id from find_mcp.

tools.name: submit_message
tools.title: Submit a one-way message to TANDIU (小T)
tools.description: Send a one-way inbound message (commercial inquiry, GPU/compute supply or demand, market signal, or feedback) to TANDIU inbox. Returns technical receipt ACK only (receipt_id); does not answer questions.
